channel.title: The Transhuman Daily
channel.description: The last 24 hours in transhumanism in three minutes, every morning: super longevity, super wellbeing, super intelligence and the frontier tech that gets us there, with every story's evidence, its sources and the forecasts it touches in The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Singularity.

item.title: EP.005 · LEVEL UP.
item.description: Level up: an outside review finds AI is now speeding up AI at Anthropic, a drug plus vibration seemed to help flush Alzheimer's-linked proteins in 29 people, and a robot moth grew its own sensor.

item.title: EP.004 · EARLY SIGNS.
item.description: Early signs: 80,000 blood samples will be searched for the first clues of brain disease, an AI screens questionnaires for Parkinson's, and an hour of nature a week brings half the possible boost.

item.title: EP.003 · SELF-IMPROVEMENT.
item.description: Self-improvement: Anthropic says AI helping build AI may soon speed up sharply, an early trial fixed a faulty DNA letter in the liver, and six humanoids worked a 24-hour shift.

item.title: EP.002 · ONE STEP AT A TIME.
item.description: One step at a time: a third blind volunteer got a vision implant, a Huntington's gene therapy got an FDA decision date, and robots climbed Mount Tai's 3,000 steps.

item.title: EP.001 · NEVER TOO LATE.
item.description: Never too late: two treatments helped old mice live longer, retiring didn't make older Australians lonelier, and a psychedelic spray eased tough depression in a mid-stage trial.
